title: TXNM Energy clears regulatory hurdle as FERC greenlights Blackstone merger deal
title_zh: FERC 批准 Blackstone 合并交易，TXNM Energy 扫清监管障碍
summary: Investing.com – TXNM Energy (NYSE: TXNM) shares are holding steady in after-hours trading following a crucial announcement that the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has authorized its acquisition by Blackstone Infrastructure.
summary_zh: Investing.com – 联邦能源管理委员会 (FERC) 发布重要公告，授权 Blackstone 基础设施收购 TXNM Energy（纽约证券交易所股票代码：TXNM），该公司股价在盘后交易中保持稳定。

title: Earnings live: Nvidia earnings will offer crucial AI update, cap off 'Magnificent Seven' results
title_zh: 实时财报：英伟达财报将提供重要的人工智能更新，为“七雄”业绩画上圆满句号
summary: The S&P 500 was on track for double-digit earnings growth, with more than half of companies having reported Q4 results so far.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数有望实现两位数的盈利增长，迄今为止已有超过一半的公司公布了第四季度业绩。

title: JPMorgan to Test Appetite for Software Debt With $5 Billion Deal
title_zh: 摩根大通将通过 50 亿美元交易测试软件债务的需求
summary: Proceeds will also refinance about $1.8 billion in Press Ganey’s debt, the people said.  Representatives for JPMorgan and Press Ganey declined to comment.  Representatives for Qualtrics and its owner Silver Lake Management didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment.
summary_zh: 知情人士称，所得款项还将为 Press Ganey 约 18 亿美元的债务进行再融资。  摩根大通和 Press Ganey 的代表拒绝置评。  Qualtrics 及其所有者 Silver Lake Management 的代表没有立即回应置评请求。

title: Banks boost venture deals to scale AI
title_zh: 银行增加风险交易以扩大人工智能规模
summary: Wells Fargo and Citigroup topped the leaderboard for AI VC investments as the financial services industry works to build and scale the technology.
summary_zh: 随着金融服务业致力于构建和扩展该技术，富国银行和花旗集团在人工智能风险投资领域名列前茅。

title: DTE’s Stargate Deal Turns Power Into Profits
title_zh: DTE 的 Stargate 交易将电力转化为利润
summary: See why DTE Energy is being framed as an AI power play: Stargate load growth, beat-and-raise results, higher capex through 2030, and key risks.
summary_zh: 了解为什么 DTE Energy 被定位为 AI 权力游戏：Stargate 负载增长、击败和提高的结果、到 2030 年更高的资本支出以及主要风险。
